==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun and Moon - The Complete Collection was released on November 6, 2018 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 43 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000079935. Optional English closed captioning is included.

Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature.
